stations.title: Dougie
stations.say: How many ropes are in the store?

stations.title: Base laptop
stations.text: Prints the ropes left after each callout.

captions: Second evening at the base. Dougie wants to know how many ropes are in the kit store.
Today the count lives on a whiteboard, and tonight it was wiped.
You write variables that keep the count and change it, in four small tasks.
Now the laptop prints the ropes in the store, before and after the callout.
Named values, kept and changed. Dougie's count survives the night.
